summary: Create a complete encrypted instance backup
description: Starts one bounded background operation. Uses SQLite backup, transactional MySQL/MariaDB dump or PostgreSQL custom dump, includes instance files and private keys, and encrypts with AES-256-GCM/scrypt. Password is never stored. Maximum 50 archives and 8 GiB per archive/payload; extra free working space is required.

403.description: Administrator permission required; backups disabled in demo mode

400.description: Invalid input or another instance operation is running
